data.notes: June 2026 is stacked for Toronto: stadium-scale tours, All Things Go and NXNE, plus Pride-week dance programming are all already confirmed.

events.title: All Things Go Music Festival Toronto 2026
events.summary: Two-day Toronto edition of All Things Go at RBC Amphitheatre. Ticketmaster lists Kesha, Lorde, The Beaches, Wet Leg, Rachel Chinouriri, Del Water Gap, Holly Humberstone, Jade LeMac, Momma, Sofia Camara, Bella Kay and Flower Face across the weekend.

events.title: ROSALÍA – LUX Tour 2026
events.summary: ROSALÍA plays Scotiabank Arena on the LUX Tour 2026. Ticketmaster lists the Toronto show for Saturday, June 13 at 8:30 p.m.

events.title: Luke Combs – My Kinda Saturday Night Tour
events.summary: Luke Combs plays two nights at Rogers Stadium with support listed by Ticketmaster including Dierks Bentley, Ty Myers, Jake Worthington and Thelma & James.

events.title: Post Malone Presents: The BIG ASS Stadium Tour Part 2
events.summary: Post Malone brings The BIG ASS Stadium Tour Part 2 to Rogers Stadium on June 16. The confirmed Ticketmaster listing gives the Toronto show time as 7:30 p.m.

events.title: Noah Kahan – The Great Divide Tour
events.summary: Noah Kahan brings The Great Divide Tour to Rogers Stadium on June 28. Ticketmaster confirms the Toronto stadium date and 6:30 p.m. show time.

events.title: NXNE Music Festival & Conference 2026
events.summary: NXNE returns as a multi-venue Toronto music festival and conference from June 10–14. The official site lists confirmed 2026 artists including Accelerant, ALX COOPER, Bitch Stick, Cherrykim, Clay Pigeon, Coda Club, DESIIRE and Elin Hall.

events.title: Mumford & Sons – Prizefighter Tour
events.summary: Mumford & Sons bring the Prizefighter Tour to Rogers Stadium on June 13. Ticketmaster confirms the Toronto date at the stadium.

events.title: The Strokes – Reality Awaits North America
events.summary: The Strokes play RBC Amphitheatre on June 21 as part of their Reality Awaits North America tour. Ticketmaster confirms the venue and 7:00 p.m. show time.

events.title: JOJI: SOLARIS
events.summary: Joji’s SOLARIS tour stops at Scotiabank Arena on June 19. Ticketmaster lists Nate Sib and Corbin on the Toronto bill.

events.title: PRISM Toronto presents Revival
events.summary: PRISM Toronto’s Pride-week Revival party takes over REBEL on June 28. Live Nation lists Mark Knight and Victor Calderone on the lineup.

events.title: Rhythm Open Air: Toy Tonics Jam
events.summary: Rhythm, House of Lords and Toronto After Dark bring Berlin’s Toy Tonics Jam to Toronto for the first time, with COEO, Cody Currie, House of Lords and Jodie D leading an open-air house/disco courtyard party.

events.title: AFRO RAVE - Outdoor Edition
events.venueName: LW Banquet & Convention Centre / 4611 Steeles Ave W outdoor location
events.summary: Aso Management bills a 2,000-capacity outdoor Afro Rave uniting Afrobeats, Amapiano, Gqom, Coupé-Décalé and Highlife, with international guest DJs representing East, West and Southern Africa.

events.title: Green Space Festival 2026
events.summary: Green Space Festival returns during Toronto Pride week from June 24–28. The official site describes the program as outdoor parties with music producers, performers and drag artists, raising funds for The 519.

events.title: Ozmozis presents Hernan Cattaneo (Extended Set)
events.summary: Ozmozis stages a daytime open-air progressive-house event at Evergreen Brick Works, headlined by Hernan Cattaneo with Manzone & Strong, timed around Toronto’s World Cup summer energy.

events.title: One World
events.summary: GreenSpaceTO’s free outdoor Pride-weekend program brings Afro House and global house to Barbara Hall Park with La Santa, KARABA, Deko-ze and DJ BlackGold alongside drag and dance performances.

events.title: LEGENDARY feat David Rodigan & DJ Starting From Scratch - Day Party
events.summary: SFS ENT and Rickey D Events present a rare outdoor day party pairing British reggae selector David Rodigan with Toronto’s DJ Starting From Scratch, spanning soul, hip-hop, R&B, soca and reggae.

events.title: Loco Dice at CODA
events.summary: Embrace presents Loco Dice with Rudee Nik and Kevin Faria at CODA, a 19+ late-night club show aimed squarely at Toronto’s house and tech-house crowd.

events.title: DESIFEST presented by TD: Celebrating 20 Years
events.summary: DESIFEST marks its 20th anniversary with two free days at Sankofa Square, including Bollywood/Punjabi remix culture and stated collisions between Afrobeats, hip-hop verses, dholak rhythms and soca energy.

events.title: Ozmozis presents Guy J (All Night Long)
events.venueName: Evergreen Brick Works / TBA - New Venue
events.summary: Ozmozis presents Guy J for a seven-hour all-night-long set in Toronto on June 20. Resident Advisor lists the event from 7:00 p.m. to 2:00 a.m. with Guy J as the confirmed lineup.

events.title: Laylit Toronto
events.summary: The Laylit collective brings its SWANA-diaspora dance party to Standard Time, blending shaabi, dabke, mahraganat, Arabic pop and hip-hop with techno, breakbeat, UKG, bass, dancehall and baile.
